text:
Luca Moretti (Employee): hey team — noticed my March payslip shows both US federal withholding and INPS social charges. i was seconded to Milan starting Feb 1 and thought social was handled by the host payroll under the mobility team.
Nina (People Ops): thanks Luca. @Ari can you confirm secondment status and whether Mobility issued A1 or other certificate?
Ari (Global Mobility): checking now. mobility-bot: Secondment record 2-2026-LM created. status: completed host payroll enrollment pending. A1 not issued (EU A1 only for social security agreement); we recommended INPS registration for host-side contribution.
Diego (Payroll): payroll extract shows US payroll flagged "on assignment" but still applied US FICA/Med and federal withholding for March. host payroll also posted INPS deductions. looks like overlap.
Sam (Manager): Luca was approved for 12-month secondment to Milan in Jan offer addendum. HR/Legal signed off. Manager reminder: pre-checklist had mobility handoff but seems step missed.
Luca Moretti (Employee): i uploaded my passport + secondment approval in the mobility portal but didn't see a confirmation about A1 or social enrollment.
Ari (Global Mobility): timeline: Mobility submitted host enrollment to our Italian payroll partner on 2026-02-05. partner confirmed enrollment 2026-02-20 but we didn't receive the A1 (if applicable). company policy: for EU moves <24 months, determine social security via local rules; Mobility was expecting host payroll to take social contributions as of assignment start.
Diego (Payroll): action items from payroll:
1) Void the US FICA/Med portion for payrun 2026-03-31 if host social applies. That requires off-cycle adjustment and coordination with tax vendor for employer-side corrections.
2) Reclassify federal withholding if resident status changed mid-year — need residency docs.
3) Provide employee with net-impact calc and updated paystub.
Nina (People Ops): what's the estimated lead time? Luca needs to reconcile for his personal taxes and budgeting.
Diego (Payroll): once Mobility confirms effective start and provides enrollment confirmation (INPS enrollment id or partner confirmation), payroll can queue off-cycle within 3 business days. backend tax vendor may take up to 5 business days for employer tax-side corrections. employee refund or adjustment depends on withhold amounts.
Ari (Global Mobility): i've requested the Italian partner to re-send the enrollment confirmation and any contributed period IDs — expecting reply 1 business day. mobility-bot: follow-up reminder set for 24h.
Sam (Manager): please keep me posted. if Luca has cashflow issues we can do a short-term gross advance.
Luca Moretti (Employee): thanks. also does this affect my year-end tax residency? i plan to stay 10 months in Italy this assignment.
Ari (Global Mobility): that falls under tax residency rules; Mobility will coordinate with tax provider. immediate priority is fixing payroll double social.
Diego (Payroll): recorded note: "Pending host enrollment confirmation from Mobility. Off-cycle to remove US social will be performed after confirmation. Federal withholding review pending residency proof (Form 673 equivalent or residency certificate)."
Nina (People Ops): @mobility-bot drop the link to where employees can upload additional residency docs.
mobility-bot: Upload portal: https://mobility.example.company/assignments/Luca_Moretti_2026. Required docs: passport, lease/employment letter, host enrollment confirmation.
Ari (Global Mobility): partner responded: "INPS enrollment ID IT-INPS-44321, effective 2026-02-01. Employer contributions recorded." forwarding confirmation to payroll now.
Diego (Payroll): received confirmation. initiating off-cycle 2026-04-02 11:05 UTC to reverse US FICA/Med for payrun 2026-03-31 and mark host social as employer-paid in records. projected reclaim to employer for employer-side taxes. employee net will be adjusted (minor delta).
Luca Moretti (Employee): saw updated payslip this morning, social deduction removed from US side and INPS appears on host statement. net change is small — thanks.
Nina (People Ops): closing loop. we'll add a checklist reminder so Mobility confirms enrollment before payroll run for future secondments. :white_check_mark:
